reason: The cited evidence shows that laser cladding of HEA+WC on 316L (E1) and on a steel knife (E6) improves hardness and wear resistance, and that a different HEA film (E3) resists oxidation and tribocorrosion, but no cited passage directly supports the specific strengthening/barrier mechanisms, the role of rapid solidification in corrosion resistance, or the uniform dispersion and metallurgical bonding for this exact system.
premises: WC particles provide solid-solution and dispersion strengthening in a HEA matrix
WC particles act as a barrier to oxidation and abrasive wear
Rapid solidification during laser cladding yields a fine microstructure that enhances mechanical properties and corrosion resistance
